hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts accrued/current operating liability burden falling versus revenue may identify companies with easing operating overhang or cleaner expense recognition; liquid SPY-relative leadership then tests whether price is recognizing that relief before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: Official SEC accrued-liability burden relief is a free PIT operating-overhang field distinct from receivables, inventory, lease, debt, SBC, AOCI, and warranty tests, but recent Companyfacts burden scouts usually failed old_thin/drawdown/comparator gates.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC accrued-liability or annual revenue facts, missing prior comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC accrued-liability tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual revenue normalization, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The accrued liability burden relief source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, aggregate_pnl_not_positive, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_sample_too_small, target_window_coverage_too_small, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It regressed no individual window, and the broad liability burden signal appears too close to generic Companyfacts accrual/liability noise without a stronger event or contract provenance edge. It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0000; aggregate PnL delta $+0.00; max drawdown drift +0.0000; 0 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping accrued-liability tags, accrued/revenue thresholds, relief percentages, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT evidence such as accrued-liability decomposition linked to named cost programs, litigation/restructuring resolution text, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep accrued-liability tags, burden thresholds, fact freshness, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
